study type: Retrospective cohort study by case-control design
exposure: maternal exposure to diurnal temperature variation (DTV) during preconceptional and prenatal periods
DTV exposure during one year before conception
DTV exposure during the three trimesters of pregnancy
Maternal exposure to diurnal temperature variation (DTV) during preconception and prenatal periods
Exposure period: one year before conception, entire pregnancy, and each trimester
cohort: 1510 children (699 with pneumonia and 811 normal controls) under the age of 14
finding: Exposure to increased DTV during the year before conception and throughout pregnancy, particularly in the first and second trimesters, was significantly associated with an increased risk of childhood pneumonia.
